title: Evaluation of the biological potential of N-(1-ferrocenyl-2-(methylthio)ethyl)anilines: antimicrobial, antioxidant, DNA-binding, and molecular docking studies.
authors: Bugarinovic, Jovana; Stepanovic, Jelena; Pesic, Marko; Stevanovic, Dragana; Sreckovic, Nikola; Mihailovic, Vladimir; Damljanovic, Ivan
one_liner_zh: 该研究评估了含二茂铁苯胺衍生物的抗菌、抗氧化及DNA结合活性，并通过分子对接初步表征其与DNA的沟槽结合，但对象为小分子-DNA互作而非蛋白质-DNA体系，方法仅涉及简单对接，缺乏AI或MD深度建模，与TF-DNA课题关联较弱。
abstract: A series of fourteen N-(1-ferrocenyl-2-(methylthio)ethyl)anilines was prepared using a simple synthetic route. Their antimicrobial activities were evaluated by assays against seven bacterial and five fungal strains. Seven derivatives displayed moderate antibacterial activity, while two compounds exhibited the most notable antifungal effects against Aspergillus brasiliensis and Trichoderma harzianum, with minimum inhibitory concentration (MIC) of 1.20 mM. The antioxidant potential was evaluated using DPPH(*) and ABTS(*+) radical scavenging assays. Compound 5b exhibited the strongest activity in the DPPH(*) assay, with an IC(50) value of 55.99 muM, which was significantly higher than that of the reference standard ascorbic acid (IC(50) = 168.58 muM). Pronounced activity in neutralizing ABTS(*+) radicals was a dominant feature of nearly the entire series, with IC(50) values for most compounds below the lowest tested concentration. The presence of the ferrocene moiety enabled DNA binding studies using cyclic voltammetry (CV) and hydrodynamic linear sweep voltammetry (HLSV). CV investigations indicated different diffusion coefficient values for the derivatives in the absence and presence of DNA, suggesting the formation of aggregates between the synthesized derivatives and DNA. The interactions were confirmed by HLSV, which proved to be an easily performed and effective electrochemical technique. Molecular docking was used to characterize the interaction of the synthesized ferrocene-containing compounds with DNA, and calculations indicate groove binding as the dominant form of interaction. Since antioxidant properties and protein tyrosine kinase (PTK) inhibition are closely connected, the synthesized compounds were also docked into the active site of beta protein tyrosine kinase to explore their inhibition potential. The results indicate three derivatives with relatively high docking scores and the ability to inhibit PTK by binding to the key amino acid center Tyr 505.
abstract_zh: 通过一条简便的合成路线制备了一系列十四种N-(1-二茂铁基-2-(甲硫基)乙基)苯胺。通过针对七种细菌和五种真菌菌株的测定评估了其抗菌活性。七种衍生物表现出中等抗菌活性，而两种化合物对黑曲霉（Aspergillus brasiliensis）和哈茨木霉（Trichoderma harzianum）显示出最显著抗真菌效果，最低抑菌浓度（MIC）为1.20 mM。使用DPPH(*)和ABTS(*+)自由基清除测定评估了抗氧化潜力。化合物5b在DPPH(*)测定中表现出最强活性，IC(50)值为55.99 μM，显著高于参考标准抗坏血酸（IC(50) = 168.58 μM）。中和ABTS(*+)自由基的显著活性几乎是整个系列的主要特征，大多数化合物的IC(50)值低于最低测试浓度。二茂铁部分的存在使得能够使用循环伏安法（CV）和流体动力学线性扫描伏安法（HLSV）进行DNA结合研究。CV研究显示，在不存在和存在DNA的情况下，衍生物的扩散系数值不同，表明合成衍生物与DNA之间形成了聚集体。这些相互作用通过HLSV得到确认，该技术被证明是一种易于执行且有效的电化学技术。分子对接用于表征合成的含二茂铁化合物与DNA的相互作用，计算表明沟槽结合是主要的相互作用形式。由于抗氧化特性和蛋白酪氨酸激酶（PTK）抑制密切相关，合成的化合物也被对接入β蛋白酪氨酸激酶的活性位点，以探索其抑制潜力。结果表明，三种衍生物具有相对较高的对接分数，并能够通过结合关键氨基酸中心Tyr 505来抑制PTK。
